summary.name: Luma AI
summary.one_liner: Luma AI is a creative AI platform for video generation, image creation, and agents that run end-to-end creative workflows across video, image, audio, and text.
use_cases: directing camera and continuity in AI video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Luma as a creative AI platform built on its own video models, Ray and Uni. Ray 3.2 is presented as a direct-to-video model that gives frame-level control and keeps continuity across cuts. Uni-1 is described as a brand-aware model that carries style references, character references, and visual grounding into generated assets. Creative agents are said to research, generate, and refine work across video, image, audio, and text, and to keep brand style consistent. The page also lists Luma Skills for saving and rerunning creative workflows, and links to research papers and a Learning Center.
notable: Ray 3.2 video model with frame-level control and cross-cut continuity
Uni-1 model that carries style and character references into assets
Creative agents spanning video, image, audio, and text workflows
Luma Skills for building reusable creative workflows
caveats: Page does not give specific pricing tiers; the 'Try it free' claim in the meta description and the directory listing's freemium tag are the only pricing signals
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated on the page
Much of the page is marketing copy with few concrete technical specifications
